LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Clotting.label: clotted wounds
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Clotting.description: Wounds were bandaged by magic and are closing faster than they otherwise would.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Freeze.label: frozen
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Freeze.description: Rime on the joints: movement is capped while the cold lasts.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Ensnare.label: rooted
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Ensnare.description: Held in place by the spell. Movement is zero; attacking is untouched.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Hex.label: hexed
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Hex.description: A mark that makes the body take more damage and mend more slowly.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_LightningCharge.label: charged
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_LightningCharge.description: Residual charge from a lightning strike. The next strike hurts more for every stack carried.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_ArcaneDot.label: sustained arcane wound
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_ArcaneDot.description: Arcane force keeps working through the wound instead of passing in one blow.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Scorch.label: scorched
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Scorch.description: A controlled burn that keeps searing the target without ever becoming a spreading fire.
